indication_area: Chronic hepatitis B (adults with compensated liver disease)
moa: nucleotide analog reverse transcriptase inhibitor (tenofovir alafenamide prodrug)

approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of VEMLIDY® for treatment of hepatitis B infection in adults with compensated liver disease. ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter. (JEFFREY S MURRAY 11/10/2016)

series_start_reason: No release from 2017 prints a Vemlidy line, and the first-quarter 2018 release (8-K Ex 99.1, 2018-05-01) is the first to print one, with a 2017 comparative column. The 2017 quarters are therefore read from the prior-year columns of the 2018 releases (2017Q1 11, Q2 22, Q3 37, Q4 52). The full-year comparative in the Q4 2018 release (122) equals their sum.
notes: Scope: worldwide brand total, the unlabelled total beneath the regional lines (U.S., Europe and Other International in 2018 to 2023; U.S., Europe and Rest of World from 2024). The 2026 releases print the Vemlidy heading on the 'U.S.' line with the regional lines beneath and the total unlabelled. Printed totals are used; they can differ from the regional sums by one unit. Four-quarter sums: 2018 (321), 2019 (488), 2020 (657) and 2021 (814) match the printed full years; 2022 (843 against a printed 842), 2023 (863 against 862), 2024 (960 against 959) and 2025 (1,071 against 1,070) differ by one unit of rounding.
